name: cybershield-training-platform
description: SaaS para entrenamiento, simulación y medición del riesgo humano en ciberseguridad.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/worker && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/api && tsc -p tsconfig.vercel.json && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
